title: Let's Play Volleyball!
summary: Siswa belajar kosakata kegiatan dan tempat di waktu luang, membuat ajakan (Let's/How about/Would you like to) dan menyatakan pilihan dengan would prefer/would rather.
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Membicarakan kegiatan seru di waktu luang dan tempat-tempat yang bisa dikunjungi.
• Menyatakan pilihan (preferensi) beserta alasannya.
• Membuat ajakan atau saran, lalu menerima atau menolaknya dengan sopan.

## Kosakata Inti

Di unit ini kamu belajar nama tempat dan kegiatan untuk mengisi akhir pekan, misalnya the mall, the food court, the stadium, go shopping, watch a concert, see an exhibition, play volleyball, dan go swimming.

I like to go shopping at the mall with my sister.
We can watch a soccer game at the stadium on Sunday.
My cousin and I want to go to a convention about comic books.

## Tata Bahasa: Ajakan dan Pilihan (Let's, How about, Would you like to, would prefer, would rather)

Untuk mengajak seseorang, pilih bentuk yang sesuai dengan lawan bicara. Let's + kata kerja dasar terdengar akrab (untuk teman). How about + kata kerja -ing atau How about we + kata kerja dasar adalah saran yang santai. Would you like to + kata kerja dasar terdengar sopan (untuk guru, orang tua, atau orang yang belum akrab). Jawab dengan Great! / OK, let's go! atau tolak dengan sopan: No, thanks. I don't want to ...

Untuk menyatakan pilihan, gunakan would prefer to + kata kerja dasar, atau would rather + kata kerja dasar (tanpa "to"). Tambahkan alasan dengan because.

Let's play volleyball after school!
How about going to the food court?
Would you like to see an exhibition with us, Mr. Rahman?
Would you prefer to watch a concert or go to the mall?
I would rather play badminton because I enjoy sports.
No, thanks. I don't want to go jogging today.

## Contoh Percakapan

Rani: Hi, Dimas! Let's do something fun this Saturday.
Dimas: Great idea! How about going to the stadium? There's a volleyball game.
Rani: Hmm, I would rather go to the mall because I need new shoes.
Dimas: OK. Would you prefer to eat at the food court or have lunch at home?
Rani: I would prefer to eat at the food court because the noodles are delicious.
Dimas: Would you like to see the robot exhibition after lunch?
Rani: Yes, I would like to. I love robots!
Dimas: Cool. Let's meet at ten o'clock.

## Ayo Berlatih

What do you like to do on the weekend?
Contoh: I like to go swimming with my brother.

Would you rather watch a movie or play volleyball? Why?
Contoh: I would rather play volleyball because it is more fun.

Invite your friend to go to the mall. What do you say?
Contoh: How about going to the mall on Sunday?

Your teacher invites you to a festival, but you are busy. How do you answer politely?
Contoh: No, thank you. I'm sorry, I have to study.

## Tips

• Setelah would rather tidak ada "to" (I would rather go ...), sedangkan would prefer selalu diikuti "to" (I would prefer to go ...).
• Pilih ajakan sesuai lawan bicara: Let's ... untuk teman, Would you like to ...? untuk guru atau orang yang lebih tua.

notes: Part 2A (pilih A/B/C) dijadikan MULTIPLE_CHOICE dengan opsi asli A/B/C; kunci mengikuti PDF (A, C, B, A, C). Catatan: situasi 1 (sahabat), 3 (teman sekelas), dan 4 (sepupu) sama-sama informal, sehingga pembedaan Let's (A) vs How about (B) pada butir 3 bersifat konvensi buku dan bisa diperdebatkan. Part 2B (unscramble) dijadikan FILL_IN kalimat utuh; penilaian sistem exact-match (tanpa beda huruf besar/kecil), jadi acceptedAnswers memuat variasi tanpa tanda baca akhir/koma dan apostrof melengkung. Part 3 True/False dijadikan READING MC dengan opsi True/False. Tidak ada butir bergambar; tidak ada butir dilewati.
